reservation_rules: Budget reservation must precede an atomic generation claim.
The reservation amount is the selected route estimate plus the configured contingency, never more than the shot ceiling.
A provider submission may consume only its linked active reservation.
Known rejection before billable acceptance releases the reservation.
outcome_unknown keeps the reservation encumbered until reconciliation or an approved accounting adjustment.
A retry requires a distinct reservation tied to the new attempt.
quality_rules: Metrics with a zero denominator are null, not zero.
Selected/accepted status is read from approved QC/review records, never inferred from provider success.
Every metric states currency, window, included entry types, and data completeness.
Cross-currency totals are prohibited without explicit FX entries.
